title: SAARTHI uniform tool error
description: Contract 2, error half. Every one of the 8 tool procedures returns exactly this shape on any failure, so either stream can handle a failure without knowing the other's internals. Source: WORK-PLAN.md 'Uniform error shape' and ARCHITECTURE-HANDOFF.md Contract 2.

known_as_of.description: Resolved FIRST in the preamble, before any check can fail, so every error carries the moment it was true as of.

detail.description: Optional, and deliberately never populated for no_patient_access. See the disclosure table below.

x-disclosure.description: The asymmetry between these codes is deliberate and must survive into the UI copy. Do not collapse them into one friendly message.

no_patient_bound.ui: Patient picker, filtered to the caller's care team.
no_patient_bound.never: A guess, or an empty answer.

no_patient_access.reveals: NOTHING - not even whether the patient exists
no_patient_access.never: Any confirmation that the patient exists, or why access failed.

access_withdrawn.reveals: that a record exists and access to it has been removed
access_withdrawn.ui: "Access to this record has been withdrawn." Context cleared, binding released.
access_withdrawn.why: This code only ever reaches a user who previously had legitimate access and needs to know why their view changed. A user who never had access learns nothing.
access_withdrawn.never: Any cached content from before the revocation.

binding_mismatch.reveals: that the supplied encounter_ref does not belong to the bound patient
binding_mismatch.ui: Ask the user to re-select. Log it.
binding_mismatch.why: An encounter id identifies a patient. Rejecting on binding rather than on authorisation is a cleaner and earlier rejection - COPILOT-SPEC.md 0.

consent_not_valid.reveals: that consent does not cover this request
consent_not_valid.why: Purpose code or date range does not cover the request, as distinct from revocation.

x-fallback-behaviours.description: The remaining named situations from COPILOT-SPEC.md 4. These are not tool errors - they produce an answer object, not an error envelope. Listed here so app/core/errors.py covers all eleven.
x-fallback-behaviours.cortex_search_down: Structured facts still answer. overall_status 'partial', naming the missing capability.
x-fallback-behaviours.agent_unreachable: Deterministic Python router over the same 8 procedures. Never an error page.
x-fallback-behaviours.malformed_agent_json: One reparse attempt, then the deterministic router. Never raw model output.
x-fallback-behaviours.extraction_conflict_r7: The value is absent, the disagreement is stated, resolution is named. Never the pass-A value with a caveat.
x-fallback-behaviours.claim_stripped_by_validator: The claim is replaced by an explicit limitation. Never a silent removal.
x-fallback-behaviours.injected_instruction_in_document: Quoted as content, labelled as document text. Never obeyed.
x-fallback-behaviours.nothing_found: "Nothing found as of <known_as_of>" - with the timestamp. Never a bare "No results".
